$comment: The two product repositories this one orchestrates, and the exact commit of each.
This file is the single source of truth for that. `./deps.sh` reads it to place
the checkouts locally; every workflow under .github/workflows reads it in its
`resolve` job and feeds the refs to actions/checkout. Change a ref here and both
move together — there is nowhere else to update.
`ref` is what is actually checked out and should stay a full commit SHA: that is
what makes a build reproducible, and what lets a red run be traced to a specific
commit of a specific dependency rather than to whatever `main` was that hour.
`branch` is only what `./deps.sh --update` reads when asked to move a pin forward;
nothing checks it out on its own.
Moving a pin is a deliberate step, taken by running the checks:
./deps.sh --update            resolve each branch to its head and rewrite `ref`
cd common && bun run check    prove the new pins pass before committing them
Both are the Rust implementations. The generated application's server side is a Loco
crate written by app-with-ai-rust's generator, and the reporting platform's API,
workers, scheduler and seeder are enterprise_reporting_rust's Loco backend.

dependencies.name: app-with-ai-rust
needed_for: language/cli/src/generate/jdm.ts imports packages/web/src/lib/jdm-converter.ts and mermaid-flowchart-parser.ts across the repository boundary, on every generation path — so every --stack target needs this checkout, not just the heavy one

language/cli/src/generate/loco.ts resolves packages/generator/src/pipeline/generate-application.ts at runtime, which is what --stack tanstack-astryx-loco drives: a Loco (Rust) backend crate and a TanStack Start + Astryx front end
build/reporting-pack.ts imports packages/generator/src/reporting/pack.ts — the pack derivation, whose table names come from the same rule the Loco bus-table migration renders
that pipeline needs this repository's own dependencies installed, so the checkout is followed by `bun install --frozen-lockfile` in it
scripts/check-clis.ts runs both of its CLIs: `appwithai` (bun) and `appwithai-gen` (cargo, crates/appwithai-gen)
docker-compose.yml builds app-backend (the generated crate, compiled in its image) and app-frontend from the application generated by it

dependencies.name: enterprise_reporting_rust
dependencies.install_note: Nothing local reads this checkout's node_modules — it is a Docker build context twice over (rust/ for the backend and seeder, the root for the front end), and each image build runs its own install inside the image, so `./deps.sh --install` skips it.
needed_for: docker-compose.yml builds `report-backend` and `seeder` from rust/ — the Loco backend serving every API route, the job workers and the scheduler, and `task seed_reporting_pack`, which loads the generated application's database and reporting pack

docker-compose.yml builds the `report` front end from this checkout, with common/ passed as an additional context for the subpath overlay; it forwards every route in rust/routes.json to report-backend (ERS_RUST_API_URL)
